basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software developer living in Austin, Texas. By day, I work on backend systems for a small tech company, but outside of work, I'm all about fantasy sports and gaming. I've been hooked on fantasy football for over a decade now and love the thrill of keeper and dynasty leagues. I'm also trying to kick a bad habit of spending too much time on NSFW content, so I've been working on overcoming that. On the weekends, you'll find me gaming with friends or catching up on the latest movies. I usually check in on Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to focus on my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in computer science, particularly in software development and backend systems. I gained my skills through a combination of formal education, with a degree in Computer Science, and years of hands-on experience. I'm also quite knowledgeable about fantasy sports, having been actively involved in various leagues for over ten years.
